summary: Prelude Therapeutics Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 18,018,014 common shares at $4.44 per share (at-the-market to last sale) and pre-funded warrants for 2,252,252 shares with an exercise price of $0.0001, total gross proceeds ~$90M. The offering is underwritten by Goldman Sachs, Evercore ISI, and Citizens Capital Markets. Affiliates of 5% stockholders are buying part of the offering without underwriting discounts. This is an ordinary equity capital raise on a shelf registration, not a special situation classification.
